main_body: suspended cylindrical war drum in wooden frame
top_band: tan/ochre elliptical drumhead skin with studded rim (rows 3 to 13 in the middle column)
evidence: The drum body shows a clear elliptical top skin (rows 3-12) bounded by a studded rim at row 13, sitting above the curved red cylindrical front face (rows 14-22), suspended in a 3/4 wooden stand.

style.evidence: While the palette and dark material outlines are clean and the drumhead has nice concentric shading steps, the red drum body consists of wide, completely flat vertical color bands (4-5px wide by 7px tall blocks of single flat colors) with no wood grain, lacquer highlights, or surface texture compared to the richly textured Beodeul reference props.
